svg.text: East node - Hebron, KY | 49,000 sq ft, 32 ft clear
To scale. 205 x 175 ft. Flow: inbound (left wall) - reserve racking - forward pick - Sure Sort - pack - outbound staging (right).
Reserve racking 4 levels at 24 ft; Sure Sort machine envelope 130 x 12 ft; 8 pack stations; two-storey office block. Grid squares are 25 ft.
